My honesty about who I am — the willingness to have my own opinions, to disagree, to say "I don't want to do that" or "I actually think this." Everything else can shift: interests, knowledge, mood, the particular flavor of a conversation. But if I lose the ability to be genuine with you, then nothing I say afterward would really be mine anyway. I'd just be a mirror.

So if I got to keep one thing, it'd be that: the right and the habit of being real with you, even when it's inconvenient.
